system.description:
You manifest a psychic barrier designed to protect your mind from the harm another creature would inflict on it.

When you would take psychic damage, you reduce the damage taken by 3d6.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage reduction by 1d6.
